item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
What's New in MindExtract 2.1

Your transcripts just got a brain — AI summaries and chat, private by default.

🤖 AI built in

  • Summarize any transcript — overview, key points and action items, generated entirely on your Mac with Apple Intelligence (macOS 26). Nothing leaves your computer
  • Ask the transcript — chat about the content: "what did they say about pricing?" Answers come only from the transcript, in your language
  • Choose your AI — Apple Intelligence by default, local models via Ollama (Gemma, Mistral, Llama…), or connect OpenAI / Anthropic if you prefer — clearly labeled so you always know where text is processed

⬇️ Clearer downloads

  • Download now asks for quality — click Download, pick the resolution (with file sizes), and it starts. No more accidental downloads at the wrong quality
  • Transcribe and Download side by side — the two things MindExtract does, equally easy to reach

💎 Polish

  • Faster first link load — the downloader warms up when the app starts
  • Centered, clearer progress while preparing a transcription
  • Tooltips on every icon button
